title: execution-state-v1
description: Pack-level execution state for multi-model-workflow orchestration. Per Ruling 2: pack-level data (status, agent_id, commit_sha, worker_verdict) lives here, not in workflow-state.

active_plan_ids.description: 并行批次内同时在飞的 Plan id 列表（B3）。execution-plan start 追加、execution-plan finish 移除。compaction 恢复以此重建全部 in-flight Plan；串行模式退化为至多 1 个元素。取代旧 current_plan_id（单数指针，已删）。

status.description: Plan-level status (e.g. 'in_progress', 'committed'). Distinct from pack-level status.

start_commit.description: Commit SHA captured at plan-execution start (state.sh execution-plan start). Used as base for Plan Implementation Review diff.

end_commit.description: Commit SHA of the last pack commit in this plan; written by track-execution-state hook when all packs in the plan are committed.

worker_agent_id.description: subagent identity of the plan-level worker (autonomous-mode dispatch). Tracks the worker that owns this plan end-to-end; per-pack worker IDs still live under packs[N].agent_id when needed.

session_id.description: Codex exec session id（C4）。修复轮 `send_input resume <session_id>` 续会话的记账依据；Codex worker 场景为 null。

worktree_path.description: 本 Plan 隔离工作树绝对路径（B2）。Coordinator 显式 `git worktree add <path> HEAD` 创建；串行模式指向 Coordinator 工作树。

branch.description: 隔离工作树对应的 plan 分支名（B6 回收 `git merge --no-ff <branch>` 的对象）。

isolation_status.description: B5 失败隔离状态机：active=在飞；isolated=失败隔离（worktree 保留不合并，不污染他人）；merged=已回收合并。
